skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basic concepts of land finance, including the differences between land tax and other financial revenues from land.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Recognizing key concepts and principles of land finance
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Identify and understand the key concepts, principles, and characteristics of land finance and land prices in practice.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing decision-making processes in land finance
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Have the ability to analyze and make decisions in tasks related to land finance and solve problems arising in specific situations.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Applying knowledge to calculate land financial obligations
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply knowledge to collect and determine various types of land prices during the implementation of land financial obligations.
Analyze real-world scenarios involving land finance.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Synthesizing research materials on land finance
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Summarize and integrate various contents and research materials on land finance.
Be proactive in studying, researching, and working in groups.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Proactive selection of issues, methods, tools, and research materials
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Be proactive in choosing issues, methods, tools, and research materials for land finance.
Be proactive in presenting research topics.

prerequisite_courses: Research Methods in Economics and Society
